scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @smartcheck/api & npm run dev -w @smartcheck/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @smartcheck/api && npm run build -w @smartcheck/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @smartcheck/api && node --import tsx --test apps/web/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @smartcheck/api && npm run lint -w @smartcheck/web
scripts.format: npm run format -w @smartcheck/api && npm run format -w @smartcheck/web
